Subject: StellaCorp intro & demo request

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking this — we'd like to schedule a product demo next week focused on latency/segmentation and compliance. Our CIO (Marco Ruiz) and VP of Engineering (Asha Patel) hope to join if possible. Can you confirm a time slot where a VP/CIO could attend? We prefer 60 minutes with a 15-minute pre-brief for execs.

Possible windows (PDT):
- Tue 9/15 11:00-12:00
- Wed 9/16 09:00-10:00
- Thu 9/17 14:00-15:00

We also attached a short security questionnaire and would need SOC2 documentation before the call. Recording is fine but we'd like to confirm opt-in.

Thanks,
Elena
Director, IT Strategy
StellaCorp

Hi Elena — great to meet you, thanks for outlining the windows.

We can run the full 60-minute demo and accommodate a 15-minute pre-brief for execs. My suggested primary slot is Wed 9/16 09:00-10:00 PDT — that gives us time to do a short pre-brief at 08:45 if Marco/Asha can join early. If the CIO isn't available, Ben Carter (copied) will attend as exec sponsor fallback and can cover high-level architecture and SLOs.

I'm also attaching the demo deck and an invite stub so we can lock the slot once you confirm. We have SOC2 in hand — happy to share the report under NDA; can I send a link to your security email or drop it in a secure Drive?

Quick asks from our side:
- Please confirm final headcount for the call (execs + engineering + procurement).
- Confirm whether recording is OK (you mentioned opt-in).
- Any specific compliance questions beyond the attached questionnaire so we prep answers in advance.

I'll join the full hour if needed, but my preference is: 08:45-09:00 pre-brief (exec-only), 09:00-09:10 exec highlight + product elevator, then hand to product/eng for the deeper run.

Attaching a calendar invite stub so Jasmine can send final invite to the Stella team once confirmed.
